# Welcome to Persistence Survival. This server is not affiliated with the official Persistence SS14 server.
Uptimes are posted on the discord.
# Server Rules
##1: Respect Others - 1.1 Be nice to others - 1.2 Don't needlessly ruin others people's fun
##2: Use Common Sense
##3: Self-Antags - 3.1 You are permitted to be an antagonist if you wish - 3.2 You must have a good reason to murder someone - 3.3 Round Removing (Gibbing or other means) is not allowed - 3.4 You must make an attempt to have someone revivable (body-bags, leaving them on a staffed station)
##4: Consider the NT station a safezone
##5: English - This is an english server, speak english
